title: Virtua Tennis
notes: The title screen waits for 5 or 7. Left alone, it switches to a demo match; any press of 5 brings the title back.
Menus are driven with 5 or the left soft key; the OK key (pad press) does nothing in this game.
Options shows the sound volume at 0 on a first start. Raise it there to hear the game.
The left soft key pauses a match (continue, end game).

controls.source: Seen by pressing keys in the menus and in a match; the game has no controls screen. 5 and 7 both serve and hit. That the two are different strokes (a normal shot and a lob, as in other versions of Virtua Tennis) is general knowledge of the game and was not checked here.

actions.up: Move the player up the court; aim the shot
actions.down: Move the player down the court; aim the shot
actions.left: Move the player left; aim the shot
actions.right: Move the player right; aim the shot
actions.5: Serve and hit; select in menus
actions.lsk: Pause a match; OK in menus

notes: The two stroke keys are on Space or Z (5) and X (7), with the arrows moving the player. Enter also presses 5, because this game selects with 5 and ignores OK.

statusNote: Runs at full speed from the title through the main menu and player selection into an Arcade match: serving, moving, rallies, scoring and the pause menu all work.
